cohort: 130 women presenting with severe pre-eclampsia, imminent eclampsia, eclampsia, or HELLP syndrome at a tertiary care hospital in Guntur, India, were included in the study.
finding: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, particularly severe pre-eclampsia and eclampsia, were associated with significant maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: The majority of women (67.69%) delivered by cesarean section.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (LBW) was observed in 40.57% of the neonates.
